The RL_SCALING_E2E phase processes requests by first performing prefill (loading model parameters into GPU memory), decoding the request using the precomputed key-value cache, and consolidating requests for efficient GPU scheduling. The KV cache stores intermediate results for faster decoding, while GPU scheduling optimizes resource allocation. Request consolidation reduces overhead by combining multiple requests, and role switching allows dynamic model transitions. All these steps ensure efficient execution of the E2E (end-to-end) strategy.
